name: Registry Consensus

question.question: What type of integrity mechanism is used by the method’s Verifiable Data Registry?

possibleResponses.label: D
possibleResponses.meaning: Electoral ‒ Select parties vote with thresholds

possibleResponses.label: F
possibleResponses.meaning: Unilateral ‒ Latest signed version defined as authentic

possibleResponses.label: G
possibleResponses.meaning: Standards-based specifications determined by institutional authority, used by anyone

relevance: The consensus mechanism used by the method registry has implications for scalability, speed of operations, security and possibly environmental impact.

exampleAssessments.note: There Veres One registry consensus algorithm uses a BFT algorithm which formulates consensus through a super majority of witness nodes with any number of peer nodes allowed to participate in the gossip network.

There Veres One registry consensus algorithm uses a BFT algorithm which formulates consensus through a super majority of 13 witness nodes with any number of peer nodes allowed to participate in the gossip network.
